answer: To resist Sybil attacks, rewards are held in escrow until a 48-hour challenge window closes. Each agent’s identity binds to a physical beacon, like a juniper-embedded RF chip. To fake an identity, an attacker must spoof a unique beacon signal, requiring a custom trellis antenna per instance. The cost: 0.67s of antenna calibration per fake, with no parallelization due to real-world RF constraints. The more identities, the longer the setup time.
